evidence.quote: Today, inflation is well below our 2 percent longer-term objective, as measured by prices for personal consumption expenditures.
In all likelihood, this path will involve continued support from accommodative monetary policy for quite some time.
In the meantime, the case for continued support for our economy from monetary policy remains strong.
But today, our private sector shows real signs of underlying improvement.
it remains well above our estimate of a longer-run, more normal level.
